name: Administration Toolbar - Content languages
description: Adds a language dropdown to the admin toolbar for creating content in available languages.
project_description:
This is the port of Administration menu - Content languages , to be used with Administration Toolbar .

 Provides a dropdown menu with available languages when adding content for all content types that default to the current language in the Administration toolbar.

 This can be useful when the "Interface text language selected for page" language setting is checked for a content type.

 Requires the following modules:

 
 Administration Toolbar
